body.name: \(\Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)\)
body.construction:
Define the published-class coefficient projection by
\[
 \Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)=
 \left\{\widetilde B:
 \exists(\widetilde P,\widetilde B,\widetilde\varepsilon,
 \widetilde\pi)\in\mathfrak F_G(\mathcal O_G)\right\},
 \qquad N_{\mathrm{out}}=|\Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)|,
\]
where set braces remove numerical duplicates. The component-aligned order set \(\Pi_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)\) remains a separately reported refinement and is not used to define this published-class coefficient estimand.
